name: toolcrib
description: AI-consumable component manifest for React UI toolkit. All units are rem unless noted.

channels.name: theme:changed
channels.payload: { parameters: ThemeParameters; palette: GeneratedPalette; cssVariables: Record<string, string>; }

channels.name: element:resized
channels.payload: { id?: string; target: HTMLElement; width: number; height: number; contentHeight: number }

channels.name: element:intersected
channels.payload: { id?: string; target: HTMLElement; isIntersecting: boolean; ratio: number }

channels.name: popup:shown
channels.payload: { id: string; targetId?: string; data?: any }

channels.name: toast:shown
channels.payload: { id: string; type: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'; message: string; priority?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'urgent' }

channels.name: toast:added
channels.payload: { id: string; type: 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error'; message: string; priority?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'urgent' }

channels.name: toast:expired
channels.payload: { id: string; message?: string; type?: string }

channels.name: toast:dismissed
channels.payload: { id: string; message?: string; type?: string; reason?: 'user' | 'expired' | 'action' }

channels.name: toast:action_clicked
channels.payload: { id: string; actionLabel: string; message?: string }

channels.name: error:boundary
channels.payload: { componentName: string; error: string; stack?: string }

channels.name: layout:corners:squared
channels.payload: { domainId: string; slot: 'first' | 'second'; orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical'; squaredCorners: { topLeft?: boolean; topRight?: boolean; bottomLeft?: boolean; bottomRight?: boolean; }; }

components.name: Accordion

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

items.description: Array of items to render as accordion panels.

type.description: `'single'` allows only one panel open at a time. `'multiple'` allows any combination.

defaultValue.description: Value of the initially expanded panel (for `type='single'`).

components.description: Data-driven collapsible panel group with animations

components.name: Card

layout.description:
Layout mode. `'auto'` enables flex filling (height:100%, flex:1) and activates
automatic corner-squaring via layout domain context (e.g. inside a Splitter).

squareCorners.description: Override which corners are squared off. `'auto'` defers to layout domain context.

components.description: Slot-based container with automatic layout domain corner squaring

components.name: CardSimple

title.description: Title text rendered in the header. Omit to skip the header entirely.

subtitle.description: Secondary text rendered next to the title in the header.

footer.description: Content rendered in the footer area. Omit to skip the footer.

actions.description: Action elements (e.g. buttons) rendered in the footer's right side.

components.description: Token-saving shorthand for simple cards without slot composition

components.name: DataTable

data.description: Array of data records to display.

columns.description: Column definitions controlling header, cell rendering, and sorting.

pageSize.description: Initial number of rows per page.

pageSizeOptions.description: Options shown in the page-size dropdown.

itemHeight.description: Height of each row in pixels (used for virtualization calculations).

containerHeight.description: Container height. `'auto'` fills available space. A number sets a fixed pixel height.

rowKey.description: Custom row key extractor for React reconciliation. Defaults to array index.

components.description: Virtualized, sortable, paginated data table with sticky headers

components.name: DropdownMenu

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Trigger element that opens the menu on click.

items.description: Array of menu items to render.

side.description: Which side of the trigger the menu opens on.

align.description: Alignment along the menu's side axis.

components.description: Data-driven action menu with separator support

components.name: Form
components.import: import { Form, FormField, FormError, Input, Select, Checkbox, Switch, Textarea, RadioGroup, Slider, SubmitButton, Button } from '#toolcrib'

schema.description: Zod schema for validation. Omit for unvalidated forms.

initialValues.description: Initial field values. Fields not listed default to empty string.

onSubmit.description: Called with validated values on successful submission.

id.description: Form element id attribute. Also used as `formId` in event bus payloads.

components.description: Zod 4 schema-driven form. Controls bind via context — no register() or onChange boilerplate

columns.description:
Number of columns, or `'auto-fit'` / `'auto-fill'` for responsive behaviour.
When using auto modes, `minColWidth` controls the minimum column width.

minColWidth.description: Minimum column width for auto-fit/auto-fill modes.

marginMode.description: Override margin/gap using the theme margin token scale.

paddingMode.description: Override padding using the theme padding token scale.

gap.description:
Gap between children. Named tokens map to theme spacing scale.
`'gap'` uses the global `--ai-margin-gap` variable.

paddingMode.description: Override padding using the theme padding token scale.

marginMode.description: Override margin using the theme margin token scale (affects gap sizing).

cornerRadiusMode.description: Override corner radius using the theme radius token scale.

components.name: Modal

id.description: Unique identifier used for event bus targeting (e.g. `aiBus.openModal('my-modal')`). Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Element that opens the modal on click. Rendered inline; the modal manages open/close state automatically.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the modal opens or closes.

width.description: Width of the modal dialog panel.

zIndex.description: Z-index layer. Uses the toolkit's Z_INDEX.MODAL tier by default.

ariaLabel.description:
Accessible name announced by screen readers when the dialog opens.
Always visually hidden — unlike `<SlideOut title>`, which is a visible
`ReactNode` header, this is a screen-reader-only string. `Modal.Header`'s
visible text is decorative only and is not otherwise wired to the
dialog's accessible name, so set this explicitly (typically matching
your `Modal.Header` text) for a meaningful announcement.

components.description: Dialog overlay with focus trap, backdrop, and slot composition

components.name: Popup

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Required trigger element. The popup anchors to this element.

placement.description: Anchoring position relative to the trigger element.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the popup opens or closes.

zIndex.description: Z-index layer. Uses the toolkit's Z_INDEX.DROPDOWN tier by default.

components.description: Anchored popover with light dismiss and corner-squaring to trigger

components.name: SlideOut

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting. Auto-generated if omitted.

trigger.description: Element that toggles the drawer on click. Rendered inline.

position.description: Which viewport edge the drawer slides in from.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state. When provided, the component becomes fully controlled.

onOpenChange.description: Callback fired when the drawer opens or closes.

title.description: Title text rendered in the drawer header.

width.description: Width of the drawer panel (for left/right positions).

zIndex.description: Z-index layer. Uses the toolkit's Z_INDEX.DRAWER tier by default.

components.description: Edge drawer overlay with backdrop blur and slide animation

components.name: Splitter

id.description: Unique domain identifier for layout context. Auto-generated if omitted.

orientation.description: Split direction. `'vertical'` = top/bottom panels, `'horizontal'` = left/right panels.

initialSplit.description: Initial percentage allocated to the first (top/left) panel.

minSize.description: Minimum percentage size for either panel to prevent collapsing.

components.description: Resizable two-panel layout with automatic corner-squaring domain

components.name: TabStrip

items.description: Array of tab definitions to render.

activeId.description: The `id` of the currently active tab (controlled).

onChange.description: Callback fired when the user selects a different tab.

components.description: Scrollable tab header with filmstrip overflow. Use TabStrip.Panel for content

components.name: ThemeEditor
components.description: Real-time HSV theme editor rendered in a SlideOut panel

components.name: Toolbar

paddingMode.description: Override padding using the theme padding token scale.

marginMode.description: Override margin using the theme margin token scale (unused, reserved).

cornerRadiusMode.description: Override corner radius using the theme radius token scale.

components.description: Horizontal action bar with left/center/right slot areas

components.name: Tooltip

id.description: Unique identifier for event bus targeting.

content.description: Text or ReactNode rendered inside the tooltip bubble.

side.description: Which side of the trigger the tooltip appears on.

align.description: Alignment along the tooltip's side axis.

delayDuration.description: Delay in milliseconds before the tooltip appears on hover.

components.description: Hover/focus tooltip wrapping a child trigger element

components.name: UIGroup

orientation.description:
Group layout direction.
- `'horizontal'` — Children laid out in a row (default).
- `'vertical'` — Children stacked vertically.

borderRadius.description: Override border radius for the outer corners.

components.description: Merges adjacent elements into a single visual compound control

gap.description:
Gap between children. Named tokens map to theme spacing scale.
`'gap'` uses the global `--ai-margin-gap` variable.

paddingMode.description: Override padding using the theme padding token scale.

marginMode.description: Override margin using the theme margin token scale (affects gap sizing).

cornerRadiusMode.description: Override corner radius using the theme radius token scale.
